title: Noetherian smooth section component is stable under generalization
statement: Under a smooth quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism to a noetherian scheme, the locus of points lying in the connected component of the section in their fibre is stable under generalization.

proof.text: Trace a specialization by a valuation trait, base change, remove the other special-fibre components, and apply connectedness of the generic fibre for a flat family with geometrically reduced special fibre.

proof_origin.note: Intermediate theorem records the core geometric argument.
